timing: Registered after primary child propagation began, before any primary transmission point or full-rate result was inspected. Existing excluded calibration numerical errors and static reactant normalization were available.
uncertainty: Eight independent chains; combine same-chain BAR logZ and logkappa before Student-t interval, retaining covariance.
primary_protocol_gates: Preserve registered time/timestep equivalence, 3% kappa precision, complete cohort, parent sampler diagnostics and domain observations.
numerical_error_threshold_scope: Stability screen informed by excluded calibration, not a claimed bound on rate bias.
reference_preflight: Temperature, reduced mass, P, beta from the free-kernel width, physical radial domain, exact model/source/binary metadata and primary correction all match.
supplementary_parent_time_halves: Report independently with 0.03 absolute diagnostic margin; does not replace registered acceptance gates.
controls: Bead/domain controls reported separately; fixed-P dynamical gates do not imply continuum or production-umbrella validation.
